objects.name: Attack Flow
objects.description: Extends STIX 2.1 with features to create Attack Flows.

objects.name: Detection technique coverage: windows-potential-appdomainmanager-hijack-artifacts-creation
objects.description: The following analytic detects the creation of an .exe file along with its corresponding .exe.config and a .dll in the same directory, which is a common pattern indicative of potential AppDomain hijacking or CLR code injection attempts. This behavior may signal that a malicious actor is attempting to load a rogue assembly into a legitimate application's AppDomain, allowing code execution under the context of a trusted process.
